title: A New Page
bodyHtml:
The candle is lit, the ink well full. Whatever fortunes and misfortunes await in the Neath — the zee-voyages, the Bazaar's bargains, the ambitions half-formed — let them be written here.

Delete this page whenever you like, or edit it to begin your own account.

title: overwhelmed
bodyHtml:
I'm a bit overwhelmed in this new and upside-down city... at the moment, I plan to focus on increasing my reputation for Persuasiveness and charm among the city's finer types.

and wasn't there some plant I needed to water...?
